import_provenance.original_title: Admissibility of gaps in infinite-time decision times
import_provenance.original_statement: Must every ordinal beginning a gap in the attainable countable decision times, or in the attainable countable semidecision times, be admissible? Here a set’s time is the least uniform supremum of halting times among its infinite-time algorithms.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: The analogous theorem for clockable ordinals does not settle these decision-time spectra.
